scenes.text: Imagine swimming at a popular beach, completely unaware that a thermonuclear bomb is sleeping just a few feet beneath the sand.
In 1958, a military jet collided with a bomber over Georgia, forcing the pilot to dump a massive nuclear weapon into the shallow waters near Tybee Island.
Today, over sixty years later, it's still out there, buried somewhere in the mud.
You might have literally walked right over a weapon capable of wiping out an entire city.
